value.rationale: Sharp zero/nonzero property and full scalar zero count are intrinsically relevant in Lu Qi-Keng weighted Bergman theory. The support-small robustness across all radial distributions, critical mass 1/3, first nontrivial profile moment corrections and transverse birth of a single off-diagonal zero answer a parameter-stability question well beyond the specific jump-weight example. The limitation fixed finite M is explicit; no claim of broad arbitrary-weight classification.
